newsitem.title: UK: Four die in Scottish food poisoning outbreak.
newsitem.headline: Four die in Scottish food poisoning outbreak.

text.p: Four elderly people have died of food poisoning in Scotland after eating suspect cooked meat and another 107 have been taken ill, British health officials said on Wednesday.
A 69-year-old man and 79-year-old woman died early on Wednesday in a hospital in the southern Scottish town of Airdrie, a day after an 80-year-old man succumbed.
Later on Wednesday another elderly woman became the fourth person to be killed by the e-coli bacterium.
Some victims had eaten steak from a local butcher's shop served at a pensioners' lunch 10 days ago.
Investigators are concentrating their probe on cooked meat provided by a local butcher, who ironically holds the Scottish Butcher of the Year award.
